quotes.name: Steel Leaf Champion
quotes.flavor: One eye open to see the truth of the world. One eye covered to gaze at the goddess within.

quotes.name: Cenn's Tactician
quotes.flavor: "A well-trained force brings peace... which brings more time for training!"

quotes.name: Mirran Crusader
quotes.flavor: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

quotes.name: Kithkin Rabble
quotes.flavor: If even the slightest hint of panic enters the thoughtweft, bakers, potters, and even medics drop their spoons and salves to take up arms.

quotes.name: Prahv, Spires of Order
quotes.flavor: Prahv, where much work is done to make sure nothing is accomplished.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

quotes.name: Dragon Engine
quotes.flavor: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

quotes.name: Extremis Elite
quotes.flavor: In the arms race to recreate the Super-Soldier Serum, something far more dangerous was let loose on the world.

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor:
"I am the Ultimate Lifeform!"
—Shadow the Hedgehog

quotes.name: Lone Missionary
quotes.flavor: His mission has become a grim pilgrimage, a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar. But he marches on alone, stubborn as the daily dawn.

quotes.name: Oashra Cultivator
quotes.flavor: "Like fruits in the field, we will be harvested when the season is right."

quotes.name: Path of Peril
quotes.flavor: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

quotes.name: Open the Graves
quotes.flavor: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

quotes.name: Trained Orgg
quotes.flavor:
"That arm's for bashin'. That one's for smashin'. That one's for scratchin'. And that one . . . I don't know what that one's for."
—Orgg trainer

quotes.name: Expropriate
quotes.flavor: Few things are more valuable than time or money—and Leovold has plenty of both.

quotes.name: Convolute
quotes.flavor: The words came to the sorcerer's lips but refused to budge any further.

quotes.name: Pattern Matcher
quotes.flavor:
"Good! Now put it with the other widdle bunnies."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Demanding Dragon
quotes.flavor: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

quotes.name: Frogify
quotes.flavor: That gnat was still hovering by the venison, and now both looked delicious.

quotes.name: Moderation
quotes.flavor: Intent: This card prevents you from casting multiple spells per turn but rewards you for your restraint.

quotes.name: Trained Cheetah
quotes.flavor: "[King Mulu's cheetahs] came riding on the winds, charging, with fangs bared and claws flexed."

quotes.name: Archmage of Runes
quotes.flavor: He's so intent on his study that others think him frozen in place.

quotes.name: Mine Collapse
quotes.flavor: "Good ol' rock," muttered Rhirhok as the shaking began. "Nice ol' rock...."

quotes.name: Phyrexia's Core
quotes.flavor:
"So even the heart of our world has succumbed."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

quotes.name: Invasion of Kylem // Valor's Reach Tag Team
quotes.flavor: "Let's give these creeps the old one-two!"

quotes.name: Envoy of Okinec Ahau
quotes.flavor: Though wary of each other at first, the Malamet and the Oltec found a common enemy in the mycoids. They began to share glyph knowledge and other crafting secrets.

quotes.name: Kher Keep
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Disciple of Law
quotes.flavor: A religious order for religious order.

quotes.name: Volcanic Salvo
quotes.flavor: Seeing it coming a mile away is little comfort if you can't get out of range in time.

quotes.name: Mage Duel
quotes.flavor: "Remember the rules. No spells to the face!"

quotes.name: Water Tribe Captain
quotes.flavor: "Follow me to the bay! Our scouts have spotted the Fire Navy's smoketrail approaching, and we shall meet them with force!"

quotes.name: Victimize
quotes.flavor:
"Die. But die knowing that your pathetic life will yield a great bounty for me."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Torture
quotes.flavor:
"It helps pass the time until you die."
—Grandmother Sengir

quotes.name: Advancing the Spirit
quotes.flavor: "I am the old ways from which we came. I am here because the universe demanded it."

quotes.name: Honor Guard
quotes.flavor: The strength of one. The courage of ten.

quotes.name: Vorel of the Hull Clade
quotes.flavor: "I used to hurl rocks and eat scraps of meat burned over a fire. Look at what I've become and tell me Simic does not hold infinite possibility."

quotes.name: Ezio, Blade of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: "Nothing is true. Everything is permitted."

quotes.name: Hurloon Wrangler
quotes.flavor: "Nothing comes between me and my Didgeridoos™."

quotes.name: Archon of Emeria
quotes.flavor:
"Archons dispense justice according to an ancient, and flawed, premise."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Spirit of the Hearth
quotes.flavor: There's comfort and safety in warm, high places.

quotes.name: Explosive Getaway
quotes.flavor: Loot decided he liked these rescuers much more than the last ones.

quotes.name: Craterize
quotes.flavor:
"'Utterly' is my favorite way to destroy something."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Bishop's Soldier
quotes.flavor: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.

quotes.name: Uthden Troll
quotes.flavor:
"Oi oi oi, me gotta hurt in 'ere,
Oi oi oi, me smell a ting is near,
Gonna bosh 'n gonna nosh
'n da hurt'll disappear."
—Troll chant

quotes.name: Mirror Wall
quotes.flavor:
"Breaking it would be about four hundred years bad luck."
—Nomad sentry

quotes.name: Ogre Savant
quotes.flavor: He's an oxymoron.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

quotes.name: Zur the Enchanter
quotes.flavor: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

quotes.name: Havengul Lich
quotes.flavor: Fusing intelligence with the power of undeath requires inspiration of the darkest kind.

quotes.name: Blood Crypt // Blood Crypt
quotes.flavor:
"Coin's no good. A potion for an ouphe liver... or else you join my supply stock."
—Auntie Grub

quotes.name: Damping Matrix
quotes.flavor: The priests tried cursing it. The mages tried dispelling it. In the end, they all obeyed it.

quotes.name: Fury Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"A rift opened, and our arrows were abruptly stilled. To move was to push the world. But the sliver's claw still twitched, red wounds appeared in Thed's chest, and ribbons of blood hung in the air."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish hero

quotes.name: Stench of Decay
quotes.flavor:
"Disa is dead, and I am left. I shall allow no others to succumb to this pestilence."
—Kolbjörn, High Honored Druid

quotes.name: Hulking Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"Some say a great cyclops turns the world in its hands, looking down upon it with its one bright eye."
—Afari, *Tales*

quotes.name: Gaddock Teeg
quotes.flavor: So great is his wisdom and spirit that many who have met him say that they stood before a giant of a man and talked to the wisest of the four winds.

quotes.name: Moonglove Extract
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: Diluted, moonglove can etch living tissue. Concentrated, a drop will kill a giant.

quotes.name: Orcish Librarian
quotes.flavor: "Us hungry, need food . . . . Lots of books . . . . Hmm . . . ."

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor: "I'm still Frankie Raye. Just a newer, better Frankie Raye. And I'm free!"

quotes.name: Captain's Maneuver
quotes.flavor: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Foundry Inspector
quotes.flavor: Automaton inspectors ensure that the Consulate's stringent standards for mass production are upheld.

quotes.name: Phoenix Down
quotes.flavor: A feather with the power to revive those who have exhausted their strength.

quotes.name: Break Asunder
quotes.flavor: "No good will come of this."

quotes.name: Krovikan Scoundrel
quotes.flavor: The few surviving humans of Krov would have welcomed the return of winter and its sterilizing cold. They often peered northward, hoping that the snow's edge had reached their infested city-tomb.

quotes.name: Metallic Rebuke
quotes.flavor:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Teleportation Circle
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Hold on to your lunch!"
—Bartleby, gnome wizard

quotes.name: Kor Skyfisher
quotes.flavor: www.MagicTheGathering.com

quotes.name: Graduation Day
quotes.flavor: Not a journey's end but its beginning.

quotes.name: Karplusan Hound
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry, they don't bite. They much prefer setting people on fire."
—Jaya Ballard, to Chandra

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: Once heard, the battle song of an angel becomes part of the listener forever.

quotes.name: Annihilate
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Atog
quotes.flavor: The bane of all artificers, the legendary Atogs devoured intricate tools to further their own twisted growth.

quotes.name: Immortal Phoenix
quotes.flavor: Their fires burn quietly, allowing the phoenixes to glide silently through the canyon.

quotes.name: Soul's Fire
quotes.flavor: An avatar he sculpts of anger and flame.

quotes.name: Savage Lands
quotes.flavor: Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

quotes.name: Bishop of Rebirth
quotes.flavor: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

quotes.name: Smash to Smithereens
quotes.flavor: The giant Tarvik dreamed that trinkets and machines caused all the world's woe. When he awoke from his troubled sleep, he took the name Tarvik Relicsmasher.

quotes.name: Glint-Eye Nephilim
quotes.flavor: When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.

quotes.name: Orcish Lumberjack
quotes.flavor:
"How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?"
—Toothlicker Harj, orcish captain

quotes.name: Terra Ravager
quotes.flavor: It lives in the mountaintops, feeds at the mountains' feet, and kills anything it finds on the path between.

quotes.name: Presence of Gond
quotes.flavor: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

quotes.name: Prismatic Vista
quotes.flavor: Visit scenic Toby Land—keeper of your secrets!

quotes.name: Waterlogged Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis

quotes.name: Temple of Triumph
quotes.flavor: All matches continue until one side is dead. No exceptions.

quotes.name: Vincent Valentine // Galian Beast
quotes.flavor: "This body is... the punishment that's been given to me..."

quotes.name: Leela, Sevateem Warrior
quotes.flavor: "Look, Doctor, good marksmanship is not a matter of luck."

quotes.name: Salt Road Packbeast
quotes.flavor:
"She huffs like she's Queen Hellkite of the Scour, but we've been together for many journeys and she's never let me down."
—Mandakh, Mardu scout

quotes.name: Beloved Beggar // Generous Soul
quotes.flavor: Charity is rare on Innistrad, but kindness is always repaid.

quotes.name: Kiln Walker
quotes.flavor: If it possesses an ability to understand and appreciate life, it has never shown it.

quotes.name: Solemnity
quotes.flavor: The arrival of the God-Pharaoh marked a betrayal of both gods and mortals.

quotes.name: Redoubled Stormsinger
quotes.flavor: "Blink or don't. You'll get hit either way."

quotes.name: Krosan Warchief
quotes.flavor: It turns prey into predator.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: It was not the first time Doom had cackled triumphantly upon completing an instrument of global domination. But this time felt different.

quotes.name: Brinebarrow Intruder
quotes.flavor: Locked in the ice of Karfell, the treasures of ancient nobles await in ruins guarded by the dead.

quotes.name: Vial of Dragonfire
quotes.flavor:
"The artificer assured me that the vial is strong enough to contain the dragon's breath. I just need to make sure to throw it far enough."
—Kunh Mei, last words

quotes.name: Bennie Bracks, Zoologist
quotes.flavor: His enthusiastic curiosity puts even the most fearsome of beasts at ease.

quotes.name: Second Wind
quotes.flavor: Vindr stormchasers believe that the same ancient forces that move the winds can also move mortal minds and hearts.

quotes.name: Harmless Assault
quotes.flavor: After encasing it in a paralyzing beam of light, the angel studied the Eldrazi as a child would study a bug, curiously and without fear.

quotes.name: Coronation of Chaos
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: When Sarevok's deception was unmasked, the cheering crowd erupted into an outraged mob.

quotes.name: Wall of Swords
quotes.flavor: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor: Orwell Orchards is about as peaceful and pleasant as a tomb can get.

quotes.name: Territorial Allosaurus
quotes.flavor: A living remnant of the Ice Age.

quotes.name: Exploration
quotes.flavor: With every step she took, a new world unfolded before her.

quotes.name: Giant Octopus
quotes.flavor:
"Before my eyes was a horrible monster, worthy to figure in the legends of the marvellous. . . . Its eight arms, or rather feet, fixed to its head . . . were twice as long as its body, and were twisted like the furies' hair."
—Jules Verne, *Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea*, trans. Lewis

quotes.name: Elvish Lyrist
quotes.flavor:
"Make me thy lyre, even as the forest is: What if my leaves are falling like its own!"
—Percy Bysshe Shelley,
"Ode to the West Wind"

quotes.name: Wind Strider
quotes.flavor: "Currents are currents, whether in sea or sky."

quotes.name: Spirebluff Canal
quotes.flavor: There's so much more to Ghirapur than can be accessed by traditional roads.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Monitor
quotes.flavor: Being one would be an honor, if the word "honor" had any meaning in Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
quotes.flavor:
"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands
To break the hosts that foul its lands."
—*Triumph of Bala Ged*, stanza 6

quotes.name: Nature's Way
quotes.flavor: Many elves incorporate the beauty of nature into their inventions. Very few capture its savagery.

quotes.name: Elfhame Palace
quotes.flavor: The elfhames are the closest thing to "civilization" the elves allow themselves.

quotes.name: Arcbond
quotes.flavor:
"If you must die today, make your death worthy of legend."
—Alesha, Who Smiles at Death

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The desert is a voracious beast, devouring both flesh and stone.

quotes.name: Rakdos Trumpeter
quotes.flavor:
"The louder their performance, the quieter we become in comparison. They are the perfect distractions, for only fools ignore the Rakdos."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor: Many scholars believe that these creatures were the result of Urza's first attempt at mechanical life, perhaps created in his early days as an apprentice to Tocasia.

quotes.name: Essence Warden
quotes.flavor:
"The more our numbers grow, the more I gain hope that Volrath and his cursed stronghold will one day fall."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: Thijarian Witness
quotes.flavor: "We honor the lost as we cannot honor our own."

quotes.name: Bred for the Hunt
quotes.flavor: Some see the world as a place of infinite wonder and knowledge. Some see it as an infinite dinner plate.

quotes.name: Powerstone Fracture
quotes.flavor:
"Move! When the powerstone blows, that behemoth will be nothing but a hole in the ground."
—Ashnod, to Hajar

quotes.name: Chivalrous Chevalier
quotes.flavor: "I treat every foe according to the highest codes of conduct. Then I kill them."

quotes.name: Sandstorm Charger
quotes.flavor:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Needle Drop
quotes.flavor:
"First it was plovers and mulldrifters. Now it's knitting needles the size of javelins."
—Calydd, kithkin farmer

quotes.name: Urban Evolution
quotes.flavor: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

quotes.name: End of the Hunt
quotes.flavor: Just because the Oriq have gone silent doesn't mean their Mage Hunters have vanished.

quotes.name: Grim Haruspex
quotes.flavor: "The monster is slain. Time to carve."

quotes.name: Ridgeline Rager
quotes.flavor: While armies battled across Jamuraa, beasts stalked the high places looking for victims.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor:
"Molten earth has no anger of its own. Only by infusing it with your own rage can the magma seethe and take shape."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Cemetery Recruitment
quotes.flavor: "There's a smoothness to my magic here that I don't find on any other plane."

quotes.name: Armored Whirl Turtle
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: Not all enormous beasts are quick to anger.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor: It takes no prisoners, but it keeps the choicest bits for Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Tree of Redemption
quotes.flavor: The executioner's tree in Thraben Cathedral holds the power to absolve more than the souls of the hanged.

quotes.name: Archangel
quotes.flavor:
"My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Urborg Justice
quotes.flavor:
"It is a narrow line between justice and vengeance."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Carrier Pigeons
quotes.flavor:
"Birds know no borders! Why, then, should we?"
—General Varchild, in a missive to King Darien of Kjeldor

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor:
"I reeled from the blow, and then suddenly, I knew exactly what to do. Within moments, victory was mine."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran royal mage

quotes.name: Seal of Doom
quotes.flavor:
"A basilisk's gaze is effective, but disposing of physical remains is a tiresome task. It's far more discreet to dissolve one's victim entirely."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Stone Giant
quotes.flavor: What goes up, must come down.

quotes.name: Skullport Merchant
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Buy something or move along."

quotes.name: Elvish Scout
quotes.flavor: Even one whose ears were closely tuned to the sounds of Havenwood could miss hearing a Scout move past.

quotes.name: Howling Banshee
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Villagers cloaked the town in magical silence, but their ears still bled.

quotes.name: Dwarven Demolition Team
quotes.flavor: Foolishly, Najib retreated to his castle at El-Abar; the next morning he was dead. In just one night, the dwarven forces had reduced the mighty walls to mere rubble.

quotes.name: Devourer of Memory
quotes.flavor: It slips silently through the still waters of the Labyrinth of Memories to feed.

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: The Battle of Baal was the bloodiest and most costly in the entire noble history of the Sons of Sanguinius.

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: Serra's blessing lies strongest upon Sursi, where her holy chapels are untouched even as evil encroaches.

quotes.name: Defense Grid
quotes.flavor:
"Properly installed, each powerstone emits a targeted electromagnetic field that halts momentum as sure as stone."
—*Tome of Obstructions*

quotes.name: Careful Consideration
quotes.flavor:
"Sages who take the time to verify their sources are rewarded for their diligence."
—Jhoira, to Teferi

quotes.name: Weapons Manufacturing
quotes.flavor:
"Soon we'll have enough firepower to rid Evendo of its bug infestation."
—General Tekvu, Kavaron Memorial Navy

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor: The vaults of the Necron Dynasties contain all manner of esoteric artifacts, most forged long before many of the younger races even existed.

quotes.name: Dragon Fodder
quotes.flavor: Atarka goblins meet their demise as readily as their Temur counterparts did, but usually under big, winged shadows.

quotes.name: Loran of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: As a scholar, she saw the sylex not as a weapon, but as a key to the past.

quotes.name: Salvation Engine
quotes.flavor:
"The Guidelight Voyagers seem to exhibit more humanity than their flesh-and-blood competitors."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Reconnaissance Mission
quotes.flavor: "We've reached the xenos HQ. Transmitting coordinates now."

quotes.name: Xenosquirrels
quotes.flavor:
"Hey Glaxxar, did you remember to seal the vents on the seat belt control module?"
—Truss, chief engineer

quotes.name: Tranquil Cove
quotes.flavor: Deep-space ports provide temporary shelter for Imperial cruisers on long voyages.

quotes.name: Maulfist Squad
quotes.flavor: "Nice invention there. Looks real fragile."

quotes.name: Falkenrath Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: In the arena, vampires set aside all pretense of honor or civilization and fight like the predators they know themselves to be.

quotes.name: Llanowar Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Soratami Mirror-Mage
quotes.flavor: "The clouds obey my whims, and you'll obey theirs."

quotes.name: Deadly Insect
quotes.flavor:
"There is no time for pain when this beast leaves its terrible sting."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order advocate

quotes.name: Hatut Zeraze Strike Force
quotes.flavor: Wakanda's dogs of war keep it safe from the shadows.

quotes.name: Favorable Winds
quotes.flavor:
"Like ribbons of wind and wisdom the coatls fly, twisting mystery into truth, shaping the clouds to suit their inscrutable will."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Gray Ogre
quotes.flavor: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

quotes.name: Hydroid Krasis
quotes.flavor: Havoc is a small price to pay for data.

quotes.name: Soulbright Flamekin
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: When provoked, a flamekin's inner fire burns far hotter than any giant's forge.

quotes.name: Street Wraith
quotes.flavor: The lamps on Wyndmoor Street snuff themselves at midnight and refuse to relight, afraid to illuminate what lies in the darkness.

quotes.name: Ancient Grudge
quotes.flavor: If there's anything a werewolf hates, it's a collar—especially Avacyn's Collar, the symbol of her church.

quotes.name: Chandra's Fury
quotes.flavor: www.MagicTheGathering.com

quotes.name: Fresh Meat
quotes.flavor: A scavenger's favorite appetizer is death.

quotes.name: Surgical Skullbomb
quotes.flavor: It crackles with the intellect of a twisted genius.

quotes.name: Moment of Triumph
quotes.flavor: "The time of salvation is at hand. Dusk washes over the world, and the Legion will rise immortal!"

quotes.name: Metallic Rebuke
quotes.flavor:
"Too little, too late. The machine is in motion."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Lupine Prototype
quotes.flavor:
"Ludevic saw it in a dream and set to work immediately, every detail already known. Can such genius be taught?"
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Surge of Righteousness
quotes.flavor: Though she stood alone, she struck with the force of an army.

quotes.name: Scroll of Avacyn
quotes.flavor: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

quotes.name: Cryptolith Rite
quotes.flavor:
"They're Avatars. All these people are your past lives, Aang. When the Avatar dies, he's reincarnated into the next nation in the cycle."
—Katara

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.

quotes.name: Leonin Lightscribe
quotes.flavor: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.

quotes.name: Decision Paralysis
quotes.flavor:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

quotes.name: Sarkhan's Catharsis
quotes.flavor: "You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas."

quotes.name: Divine Visitation
quotes.flavor: The angels appreciated the offer but politely declined to eat any birdseed.

quotes.name: Plaguecrafter
quotes.flavor: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

quotes.name: Savage Surge
quotes.flavor:
"I thought its back was turned!"
"A centaur has two backs!"

quotes.name: Citywide Bust
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, you fellas are going to love the lockup. Excellent gruel. Very low ceilings."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Atomwheel Acrobats
quotes.flavor:
"If the acrobatic show doesn't wow the audience, we have no one to blame but our elves."
—Myra the Magnificent

quotes.name: Dread Charge
quotes.flavor:
"As equal were their souls, so equal was their fate."
—John Dryden, "Ode to Mrs. Anne Killigrew"

quotes.name: Celestial Enforcer
quotes.flavor: "I look to the heavens for hope, but you will kneel."

quotes.name: Locthwain Gargoyle
quotes.flavor:
"As the traitor hurried across the courtyard, its eyes snapped open. It was time to pay the queen a visit."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
quotes.flavor: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

quotes.name: Rise to Glory
quotes.flavor: A hero dies, and a legend arises.

quotes.name: Entangler
quotes.flavor: "Tell me again," said Latulla, raising her fist, "how just one woman held back an entire Keldon platoon."

quotes.name: Gigantosaurus
quotes.flavor:
「歯の一本一本が馬ほどの長さで、新しい歯が16日おきに生えてくるの。もっと近くで見てみましょう。」
――ビビアン・リード

quotes.name: Braid of Fire
quotes.flavor: The prominence danced before the shaman, a tangle of power and flame—his to unravel.

quotes.name: Dauthi Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: In their twisted logic, to empty the shadow world is to escape it.

quotes.name: Malicious Affliction
quotes.flavor:
"Such an affliction appears to seek out the pure."
—Byro, plague doctor

quotes.name: Monstrous Step
quotes.flavor: Life is best taken one step at a time.

quotes.name: Unwinding Clock
quotes.flavor:
"The partisans have unearthed a strange artifact. None know its origin, but it gives them hope of a life beyond."
—Elspeth's journal

quotes.name: Pendelhaven
quotes.flavor: "This is the forest primeval. The murmuring pines and the hemlocks . . . / Stand like Druids of old." —Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, "Evangeline"

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

quotes.name: Sigil of the Empty Throne
quotes.flavor: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

quotes.name: Violent Outburst
quotes.flavor: Yarn unspooled, squeaky toys de-squeaked, upholstery torn to shreds—it was carnage.

quotes.name: Fire Servant
quotes.flavor:
"Elemental fire shimmers with rose hues and, unlike terrestrial blazes, smolders long after it's extinguished."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

quotes.name: Open the Vaults
quotes.flavor:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

quotes.name: Turn to Mist
quotes.flavor:
"Did you expect me to dodge? How quaint."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

quotes.name: Geistcatcher's Rig
quotes.flavor: The rigs were outlawed except in Nephalia, where malign spirits are as plentiful as crazed inventors.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

quotes.name: Cryogen Relic
quotes.flavor: Older than the Eumidian seedships that populated Evendo.

quotes.name: Town Sentry
quotes.flavor:
"So he gots a sword. Big deal."
"Yeah, it's a big deal—it's a big sword!"
—Two goblins outside the gates of Trokin

quotes.name: Rangers of Ithilien
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "We have a new errand on this journey: to ambush the Men of Harad."

quotes.name: Viashino Sandswimmer
quotes.flavor: Few swim in a place of such thirst.

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor:
"I do not wish to speak with you, but through you. You are the prophet. You've played your part."
—Minerva

quotes.name: War Priest of Thune
quotes.flavor: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Western Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Expect nothing but scorn, flattery, and lies. And never turn your back on him."
—Northern paladin

quotes.name: Archangel Avacyn // Avacyn, the Purifier
quotes.flavor: Pray.

quotes.name: Bant Sureblade
quotes.flavor: Soldiers who fought through Grixis learned to hit first, recite the prayer of Asha later.

quotes.name: Sigil Blessing
quotes.flavor: "For unwavering commitment and unflinching strength, the Order of the White Orchid confers its sigil. Rise, knight-captain, and do your duty."

quotes.name: Trygon Predator
quotes.flavor: Held aloft by metabolized magic, trygons are ravenous for sources of mystic fuel.

quotes.name: Cobblebrute
quotes.flavor: Ravnica's most ancient streets take on a life of their own. A few have decided to move to nicer neighborhoods.

quotes.name: Withering Boon
quotes.flavor:
"Life for life: this is the immutable law."
—Panya, Granger Guildmage

quotes.name: Grollub
quotes.flavor: Mogglings caught in a misdeed often blame the grollub. Even though the creature is usually innocent, no taskmaster can resist an excuse to beat it.

quotes.name: Maze Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The route has been known for millennia, but only by those with no means to tell it.

quotes.name: Peach Garden Oath
quotes.flavor:
"We three, though of separate ancestry, join in brotherhood. . . . We dare not hope to be together always but hereby vow to die the selfsame day."
—Peach Garden Oath

quotes.name: Firewing Phoenix
quotes.flavor:
"When a phoenix nests in a volcano, we rejoice, for it means a hundred years of war."
—Golmak, Keldon warlord

quotes.name: Veteran Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: Good bodyguards are hard to find, mainly because they don't live long.

quotes.name: The Third Doctor
quotes.flavor: "It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."

quotes.name: Prairie Stream
quotes.flavor: The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

quotes.name: Dissipate
quotes.flavor:
"Morning light, morning light,
Chase away the fears of night."
—Gavony children's rhyme

quotes.name: Trapped in the Tower
quotes.flavor: "At least up here I have some peace and quiet."

quotes.name: Borderland Minotaur
quotes.flavor:
"You have led us to triumph over the forces of Mogis!" said Brygus the Brave, clapping the Champion on the back. The Champion wiped the sweat and blood from her brow. "I count eight graves," she said. "Too many to call this a victory."
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Three Steps Ahead
quotes.flavor: She'd planned for every eventuality, with the obvious exception of failure.

quotes.name: Goblin Warchief
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

quotes.name: Dark Suspicions
quotes.flavor:
"After four thousand years, you learn to plan for betrayal."
—Urza

quotes.name: Karplusan Giant
quotes.flavor:
"They aren't the brightest or the quickest of giants. For that matter, the same holds true if you compare them to rocks."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!"
—Marsden, party leader, last words

quotes.name: Release to the Wind
quotes.flavor: "Here and gone like a fleeting breeze."

quotes.name: Jeskai Sage
quotes.flavor: "The one who conquers the mind is greater than the one who conquers the world."

quotes.name: Reminisce
quotes.flavor: "Leave the door to the past even slightly ajar and it could be blown off its hinges."

quotes.name: Mire Triton
quotes.flavor: Caught between life and death, between land and sea, between thought and oblivion.

quotes.name: Minwu, White Mage
quotes.flavor: "I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded."

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor: The soldier had given up his wealth, his title, even his home, but he had no room for regret. At last, he had saved his friend.

quotes.name: Cruel Revival
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

quotes.name: Pulse of Murasa
quotes.flavor: "Little flower twirl and bloom, arise from this your rocky tomb. Little warrior slash and brawl, be born again to free us all."

quotes.name: Bonds of Faith
quotes.flavor:
"What cannot be destroyed will be bound."
—Oath of Avacyn

quotes.name: Entourage of Trest
quotes.flavor:
"The dim resort to violence, for which the nimble prepare."
—Leovold, emissary of Trest

quotes.name: Feast of the Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"Could there be a fouler act? No doubt the baron knows of one."
—Autumn Willow

quotes.name: Spectral Sailor
quotes.flavor:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Faeburrow Elder
quotes.flavor: Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.

quotes.name: Path of the Enigma
quotes.flavor: "We were caught unprepared once. I won't let it happen again."

quotes.name: Gatekeeper of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."

quotes.name: Archdemon of Unx
quotes.flavor: The necropolis at Unx was once a living city, its streets untrodden by death.

quotes.name: Rise of the Witch-king
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face.

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

quotes.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
quotes.flavor: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

quotes.name: Hatching Plans
quotes.flavor:
"The thief fled with her ill-gotten prize, her mind awhirl with visions of wealth and glory. In her pack, unnoticed, the egg began to stir and crack."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Used carefully, material has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

quotes.name: Serra Avenger
quotes.flavor:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

quotes.name: Sanctum Gargoyle
quotes.flavor: As their supplies of etherium dwindled, mechanists sent gargoyles farther and farther afield in search of salvage.

quotes.name: Disciple of Bolas
quotes.flavor: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

quotes.name: Jamuraan Lion
quotes.flavor:
Der Löwe zwinkerte
—Ausdruck der Femeref für "noch einmal davongekommen sein"

quotes.name: Slate Street Ruffian
quotes.flavor:
"Merciless to the point of psychosis. Let's give him a job."
—Zelinas, Orzhov recruiter

quotes.name: Rivendell
quotes.flavor:
"Were I to go where my heart dwells, I would now be wandering in the fair valley of Rivendell."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Unsummon
quotes.flavor: Not to be. That is the answer.

quotes.name: Warrior Angel
quotes.flavor: She represents not hope, but hope's desperate fury.

quotes.name: Tinker's Tote
quotes.flavor: Never leave home without a gnome.

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor:
"You go break up that bar brawl yet? People are gonna get hurt unless you step in."
—Sheriff Marion

quotes.name: Brute Force
quotes.flavor: Blood, bone, and sinew are magnified, as is the rage that drives them. The brain, however, remains unchanged—a little bean, swinging by a strand in a cavernous, raving head.

quotes.name: Decompose
quotes.flavor:
"Sheesh! How am I supposed to make a decent living around here?"
—Cabal grave robber

quotes.name: Dawnhart Rejuvenator
quotes.flavor: "Wherever there is life, there is power for one who knows the old ways."

quotes.name: Sabertooth Wyvern
quotes.flavor: Most creatures grow out of their baby teeth, but sabertooth wyverns grow into theirs.

quotes.name: Hypnotic Specter
quotes.flavor:
"…There was no trace Of aught on that illumined face…."
—Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

quotes.name: Orochi Sustainer
quotes.flavor: "Nothing is the same anymore. The forests are not as lush, the waters not as pure, the air not as clear. Without the kami to direct and sustain the forces of nature, it's only a matter of time before we feel their neglect."

quotes.name: Goblin S.W.A.T. Team
quotes.flavor: They put the "special" in special weapons and tactics.

quotes.name: Monastery Swiftspear
quotes.flavor: The calligraphy of combat is written with strokes of sudden blood.

quotes.name: Faerie Seer
quotes.flavor: "The patterns of crossing ripples reveal the future to those who know how to read them."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rebirth
quotes.flavor: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

quotes.name: Black Knight
quotes.flavor: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

quotes.name: Break Out
quotes.flavor: "Hey, kiddo. Your ride's here."

quotes.name: Titan's Presence
quotes.flavor: Dust and memory are all that remain in Ulamog's wake.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

quotes.name: Pyretic Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Alone, we are but the heat, the air, and the kindling. Together, we are the ever-spreading flame."
—*The Sisters of Flame*

quotes.name: Falkenrath Reaver
quotes.flavor:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

quotes.name: Flood
quotes.flavor: "A dash of cool water does wonders to clear a cluttered battlefield." —Vibekke Ragnild, *Witches and War*

quotes.name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
quotes.flavor: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

quotes.name: Pyroclasm
quotes.flavor: Chaos does not choose its enemies.

quotes.name: Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker
quotes.flavor: "Zendikar still seems so far off, but Chandra is my home."

quotes.name: Capital Guard
quotes.flavor: Fire Nation guards rely more on fear than fire.

quotes.name: Mold Shambler
quotes.flavor: When civilization encroaches on nature, Zendikar encroaches back.

quotes.name: Spawnwrithe
quotes.flavor: Its victims feel only an itchy, wriggling feeling just under their skin. By then, it's far too late.

quotes.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
quotes.flavor:
"Unfortunately, all my test animals have died or escaped, so I shall be the final subject. I feel no fear. This is a momentous night."
—Laboratory notes, final entry

quotes.name: Lightning Diadem
quotes.flavor: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Thornscape Familiar
quotes.flavor: Blessed with many options, Thornscape masters favor scarabs as familiars.

quotes.name: Auriok Salvagers
quotes.flavor: "Memnarch or the vedalken salvage most of the large machines, leaving us only scraps. Scraps are enough."

quotes.name: Dungeon Shade
quotes.flavor: A sickness stirs in its eyes, a nightmare born in darkened wails.

quotes.name: Biovisionary
quotes.flavor: He tired of his fellow researchers and their useless prattling, so he decided to make a network of scholars with whom he could carry a conversation.

quotes.name: Cold Case Cracker
quotes.flavor: "It's a rare privilege to investigate one's own death."

quotes.name: Idol of Oblivion
quotes.flavor: "Arise, great one, and cleanse the world of our enemies!"

quotes.name: Rite of Flame
quotes.flavor: Once attached, the chains remained so. Chained and seared to the flesh—a part of the bearer's body.

quotes.name: Holy Strength
quotes.flavor: Such power protects the body with the strength of the soul.

quotes.name: Hunted Nightmare
quotes.flavor:
"The cruelest monsters inspire the greatest tales. The greatest tales inspire the cruelest hunters."
—Rielle, the Everwise

quotes.name: Gravelgill Axeshark
quotes.flavor:
"Their sharp scales would make good armor, if they'd just stay dead."
—Taeryn, cinder armorkeep

quotes.name: Dosan's Oldest Chant
quotes.flavor: As Dosan's chant grew in volume, a second, deeper voice rose up in harmony behind it, strong enough to shake the earth and yet vibrant enough to fill the spirit.

quotes.name: Call to the Void
quotes.flavor: Bhaal's mortal children carried within them a darkness that, left unchecked, would devour them all.

quotes.name: Tinybones, Trinket Thief
quotes.flavor: "Truth is, the game was rigged from the start."

quotes.name: Flatline
quotes.flavor:
"We've found the missing people- they're in the walls!"
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Somberwald Sage
quotes.flavor: "You can face any danger when all of nature is on your side."

quotes.name: Spell Pierce
quotes.flavor:
"One does not need to be stronger than their opponent. You need only force them to play their hand before you've shown your own."
—*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*

quotes.name: Dhund Operative
quotes.flavor: Baral's spies always have the latest technology.

quotes.name: Midnight Banshee
quotes.flavor: Many have heard the beginning of its low, sustained shriek but few the end.

quotes.name: The Speed Demon
quotes.flavor: Caution is for those who falter.

quotes.name: Water Elemental
quotes.flavor: Unpredictable as the sea itself, Water Elementals shift without warning from tranquility to tempest. Capricious and fickle, they flow restlessly from one shape to another, expressing their moods with their physical forms.

quotes.name: Incremental Blight
quotes.flavor: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage has been driven insane by the sound of the millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Virus Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

quotes.name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
quotes.flavor: Late at night it searches for students congregating where they shouldn't be.

quotes.name: Sen Triplets
quotes.flavor: They are the masters of your mind.

quotes.name: Gavony Ironwright
quotes.flavor: "I wish my work could shelter everyone, yet I pray we are never so few that it does."

quotes.name: White Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor: After the Battle of Liet Field, the white sun crested above Taj-Nar, bringing hope to all who survived the carnage.

quotes.name: Groundswell
quotes.flavor: "This world will not be tamed."

quotes.name: Vexing Devil
quotes.flavor: It's not any fun until someone loses an eye.

quotes.name: Teremko Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"When we're aloft, I love to lean over the *Weatherlight*'s railing and watch the patterns the griffins' shadows make on the clouds below."
—Sisay, Captain of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Selesnya Guildgate
quotes.flavor: The Selesnya welcome all to help them heal the city's wounds. The price, however, is devotion to the guild and a selfless belief in Trostani.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor:
"It was probably a lousy spell in the first place."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: North Pole Patrol
quotes.flavor: Waterbenders patrol the coast each day for good fishing spots and bad weather omens.

quotes.name: Armored Transport
quotes.flavor:
"If only our jails were as secure."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Elderwood Scion
quotes.flavor: The Sunbriar druids believe that every life begins in its heart and ends under its hooves.

quotes.name: Harmonize
quotes.flavor:
"Life's greatest lessons don't come from focus or concentration. They come from breathing and simply noticing."
—Seton, centaur druid

quotes.name: Wolf in _____ Clothing
quotes.flavor: "And to think, I came in here looking for someone to eat."

quotes.name: Young Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: Immolation is the sincerest form of flattery.

quotes.name: Shocking Sharpshooter
quotes.flavor:
"An arrow alone can't fell a dragon, but an added bolt of lightning brings it tumbling to the ground."
—Balur, Mardu warrior

quotes.name: Animate Library
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the books hit back.

quotes.name: Autumnal Gloom // Ancient of the Equinox
quotes.flavor:
"When the leaves fall and the nights grow cold, look elsewhere for firewood."
—Ola of Lambholt

quotes.name: Fishliver Oil
quotes.flavor: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

quotes.name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
quotes.flavor: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

quotes.name: Bronzebeak Moa
quotes.flavor: They fight for their home with more loyalty than any conscript.

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Vodalian Wave-Knight
quotes.flavor: As Phyrexian portals roared open, she whispered a prayer to Svyelun for the strength to cleanse the sky.

quotes.name: Commander Liara Portyr
quotes.flavor: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

quotes.name: Greater Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"Two legs by day, four legs by night, eyes raging in storm-gotten might."
—Ancient Northland riddle

quotes.name: Coastal Piracy
quotes.flavor:
"Mighty kind of these fellows to keep our riches safe for us. Let's go thank 'em properly!"
—Edward "Blackbeard" Thatch

quotes.name: Psionic Sliver
quotes.flavor: They evolved the ability to concentrate their neural activity into a single pulse, causing a disruptive but usually suicidal blast of psionic energy.

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: Mystic Snake
quotes.flavor: Its fangs are in your flesh before its hiss leaves your ears.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness
quotes.flavor: The contagion spreads and the Multiverse quakes.

quotes.name: Creeping Mold
quotes.flavor:
"Mold could catch you."
—Suq'Ata insult

quotes.name: Brotherhood's End
quotes.flavor:
"Two strong wills, one wake of destruction."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the hero.

quotes.name: Netcaster Spider
quotes.flavor: It is an expert at culling individuals who stray too far from the herd.

quotes.name: Aladdin's Ring
quotes.flavor: Some say Aladdin's third wish was for this ring.

quotes.name: Super Secret Tech
quotes.flavor: "Ooh . . . shiny!"

quotes.name: Pelakka Wurm
quotes.flavor: It eats what it wants to eat—which is anything that moves.

quotes.name: Elven Palisade
quotes.flavor:
"Volrath is not the only one who can shape this world to serve him."
—Eladamri, Lord of Leaves

quotes.name: EPF Point Squad
quotes.flavor: Not all humans fear the unknown. The Earth Protection Force specializes in teaching the unknown to fear them instead.

quotes.name: Paladin of Atonement
quotes.flavor: For every wound there is a blessing; for every death, a reckoning.

quotes.name: Stealer of Secrets
quotes.flavor: The Dimir would hire her, if only they knew where she lived. The Azorius would condemn her, if only they knew her name.

quotes.name: Hanweir Watchkeep // Bane of Hanweir
quotes.flavor: He scans for wolves, knowing there's one he can never anticipate.

quotes.name: Glory of Warfare
quotes.flavor: "Their hopes dashed on our shields! Their victory slashed by our swords!"

quotes.name: Gogo, Master of Mimicry
quotes.flavor: "I see... so, you seek to save the world. Then I guess that means I shall save the world as well. Lead on! I will copy your every move."

quotes.name: Chromatic Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"Let insight and energy be your guides."
—The Blind Seer, to Gerrard

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Dromoka Dunecaster
quotes.flavor: "The dragonlords rule the tempests of the skies. Here in the wastes, the storms are mine to command."

quotes.name: Arctic Flats
quotes.flavor:
"A realm once green now ruled by Frost,
Where flesh and field both pay its cost.
Those dearly loved, forever lost . . ."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

quotes.name: Witchstalker Frenzy
quotes.flavor: The witchstalkers circled the armored figure, drawn to the corrupting stink of dark magic. Kellan and Ruby fled to the sound of savage howls and snapping jaws.

quotes.name: Stolen Strategy
quotes.flavor: "Hacking is just good science!"

quotes.name: Crucible of Worlds
quotes.flavor: Amidst the darkest ashes grow the strongest seeds.

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti Djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Braided Net // Braided Quipu
quotes.flavor: The Oltec repurpose objects out of reverence rather than scarcity, believing them strengthened by the memory of each past function.

quotes.name: Nexus Wardens
quotes.flavor: The Summer Nexus is a holy grove in Setessa where the starfields of Nyx glitter in the shadows.

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor:
"It saddens me to lose a source of inspiration. This one seemed especially promising."
—Ashiok

quotes.name: Drag Under
quotes.flavor: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

quotes.name: No Rest for the Wicked
quotes.flavor:
"The soul? Here, we have no use for such frivolities."
—Sitrik, birth priest

quotes.name: Youthful Scholar
quotes.flavor:
"Too dumb, and you end up a sibsig. Too smart, and you end up a meal. Mediocrity is the key to a long life."
—Mogai, Silumgar noble

quotes.name: Fanatical Strength
quotes.flavor: "What is this? An ambush or a staring contest?" Kaya taunted. As if in answer, the robed figure lunged forward.

quotes.name: Forsaken Sanctuary
quotes.flavor:
"Prayers will curdle on the tongue and be heard by rotting ears."
—Minaldra, the Vizag Atum

quotes.name: Spectral Shield
quotes.flavor:
"What can be a stronger shield than concealment? Have you ever defeated an enemy you didn't know existed?"
—Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen

quotes.name: Enlarge
quotes.flavor: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

quotes.name: Stronghold Machinist
quotes.flavor: She stretches the laws of physics until they snap.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
quotes.flavor:
"It could be anywhere. It could be anyone."
—Emergency transmission

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Orzhov Advokist
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov care not for repentance, only repayment.

quotes.name: Shire Terrace
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.

quotes.name: Hussar Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"You think no one is watching, you think you're smart enough to escape, and most foolish of all, you think no one cares."
—Arrester Lavinia, Tenth Precinct

quotes.name: Bog Imp
quotes.flavor: Think of it as a butcher knife with wings.

quotes.name: Ember Beast
quotes.flavor:
Spot one ember beast, attack.
Spot a second, best fall back.
—Dwarven saying

quotes.name: Dungeon Crawler
quotes.flavor:
"I think of it as giving them another chance to achieve their potential."
—Nestus Wrasse, necromancer

quotes.name: Frontier Bivouac
quotes.flavor:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

quotes.name: Remand
quotes.flavor: For the Azorius, the law can be a physical shield against chaos and anarchy.

quotes.name: Fabricate
quotes.flavor:
"I do wish he'd take some time to rest, but it appears the 'fate of the world is at stake' or some such poppycock. It's very bothersome."
—Edwin Jarvis, Stark butler

quotes.name: Deadly Dispute
quotes.flavor: "That's a pretty ring! Trade you my knife for it."

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Blue Sun's Zenith
quotes.flavor:
"The Origin Query will wait. We must ensure we survive to return to it."
—Pelyus, vedalken ordinar

quotes.name: Imperial Aerosaur
quotes.flavor: Its assistance is unnervingly similar to its hunting technique.

quotes.name: Relic of Sauron
quotes.flavor: While the power of Sauron grew, light and living things forsook his borders.

quotes.name: Urban Evolution
quotes.flavor: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

quotes.name: Avacyn, Angel of Hope
quotes.flavor: A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.

quotes.name: Rain of Thorns
quotes.flavor: When the forests became havens for evil, the archmages devised new ways to cleanse the wilds.

quotes.name: Chaos Confetti
quotes.flavor: And you thought that was just an urban legend.

quotes.name: Dakmor Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"Cursed be the sickly forms that err from honest Nature's rule!"
—Alfred, Lord Tennyson, "Locksley Hall"

quotes.name: Slayers' Stronghold
quotes.flavor:
"Today the No. 1 Reactor was bombed. The terrorist group Avalanche has claimed responsibility for the bombing."
—President Shinra

quotes.name: The Keeper of Favorite Cards
quotes.flavor: CARD.

quotes.name: Cursed Mirror
quotes.flavor:
"It's a juddering dimensional portal in a mirror in a Norwegian bedroom."
—The Thirteenth Doctor

quotes.name: Puresteel Paladin
quotes.flavor: "I wear the armor. I am the weapon."

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

quotes.name: Thought Scour
quotes.flavor:
"As you inject the *viscus vitae* into the brain stem, don't let the spastic moaning bother you. It will soon become music to your ears."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Chapel Geist
quotes.flavor: Death has bound it with chains of past regrets. Forever it searches for atonement, each kindness removing a single link.

quotes.name: Sword of the Animist
quotes.flavor: From the great rock that fell from the sky, Bashenga, the first king, forged a blade to protect the land.

quotes.name: Archon of Cruelty
quotes.flavor: Malice spreads on wings of tyranny.

quotes.name: Sunfire Torch
quotes.flavor: "Let Tilonalli's light burn a path through this darkness."

quotes.name: Thundering Spineback
quotes.flavor:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Dragon Mage
quotes.flavor: "You'll bend to my will—with or without your precious sanity."

quotes.name: Belbe's Armor
quotes.flavor: It protects her from the ravages of Phyrexia and the savages of Rath.

quotes.name: Bucky Barnes, Eager Ally
quotes.flavor: "Yes sir, Cap! I won't let you down."

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Scarecrone
quotes.flavor: Her poppets bring joy to the truly depraved.

quotes.name: Hell to Pay
quotes.flavor: For years afterward, lucky explorers who found the cave could chip gold fragments off the rocky walls.

quotes.name: Storrev, Devkarin Lich
quotes.flavor: In times of war, only death flourishes.

quotes.name: Grizzly Bears
quotes.flavor: Don't try to outrun one of Dominia's Grizzlies; it'll catch you, knock you down, and eat you. Of course, you could run up a tree. In that case you'll get a nice view before it knocks the tree down and eats you.

quotes.name: Elves of Deep Shadow
quotes.flavor: "We always strive to maintain our decomposure."

quotes.name: Searing Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The first wind of ascension is Forger, burning away impurity."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Hour of Reckoning
quotes.flavor: Those who are chosen do not doubt. Those who remain do not lament.

quotes.name: Hoof Skulkin
quotes.flavor: It hunts with the memory of a long lost herd.

quotes.name: Carnophage
quotes.flavor:
"And in their blind and unattaining state their miserable lives have sunk so low that they must envy every other fate."
—Dante, *Inferno*, trans. Ciardi

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
「ファイレクシアは虚空から生まれた。 機械の父、偉大なるヨーグモスはその完成された形を予見なされた。 かくして『偉大なる進化』が始まった。」
———ファイレクシア経典

quotes.name: Bruse Tarl, Roving Rancher
quotes.flavor: "I find a world where the herds finally listen to me, but now the *plants* have an attitude?"

quotes.name: Orazca Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"If you come across a raptor in the city, stay perfectly still. At least then you'll be well rested when you die."
—Captain Brandis Thorn

quotes.name: Gaea's Blessing
quotes.flavor: A simple sacrifice: his heart for the world.

quotes.name: Reef Pirates
quotes.flavor: Relentless as the tides, souls dark as a moonless night. Bloodshed on their minds, and greed burning in their hearts like molten gold.

quotes.name: Teferi's Time Twist
quotes.flavor: "The safest place for you is not now."

quotes.name: Hammerheim
quotes.flavor: "'Tis distance lends enchantment to the view,/ And robes the mountain in its azure hue." —Thomas Campbell, "Pleasures of Hope"

quotes.name: Six-y Beast
quotes.flavor: Is it six?

quotes.name: Ashnod's Altar
quotes.flavor:
"If you work at sawing up carcasses, you notice how the joints fit, how the nerves are arrayed, and how the skin peels back."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Makeshift Munitions
quotes.flavor: "Grease up a firecannon good and proper with dinosaur-liver oil, and it'll shoot just about anything."

quotes.name: Viridian Shaman
quotes.flavor: She stands as a living symbol of the natural world and an enemy of the forces that threaten it.

quotes.name: Sylvan Scrying
quotes.flavor:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Horned Troll
quotes.flavor: Sword hilts jut from some trolls' bodies where wounds healed so fast that the weapons were trapped inside.

quotes.name: Angel of Glory's Rise
quotes.flavor: "Justice isn't done until undeath is undone."

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor:
"It's frustrating, isn't it, to be so weak and ineffectual? Don't worry, you'll be *compleat* soon enough."
—Rona

quotes.name: Halberdier
quotes.flavor: His reputation precedes him—and so does his weapon.

quotes.name: Greenwheel Liberator
quotes.flavor: "I will not rest until every vestige of the Consulate—every banner, flag, and standard—has fallen."

quotes.name: Spitting Image
quotes.flavor: Spitting is the customary greeting between a creature and its magical impostor.

quotes.name: Engulf the Shore
quotes.flavor:
"The tides have begun to ignore the moon."
—Tamiyo's journal

quotes.name: Errant, Street Artist
quotes.flavor: Few know her face, but everyone knows her work.

quotes.name: Demolisher Spawn
quotes.flavor: It rips through the Hauntwoods like a chainsaw, leaving a crushed and bloody trail behind.

quotes.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
quotes.flavor: "As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"

quotes.name: Temple of Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri

quotes.name: Field Creeper
quotes.flavor: As it walks across the fallow field, its awkward, loping gait matches the rattling in its head to create a haunting rhythm that chills the bones.

quotes.name: Gluttonous Zombie
quotes.flavor: Greed and gluttony led him to death. Now they are his greatest assets.

quotes.name: Prismatic Ending
quotes.flavor: Right before his demise, he experienced a shattering revelation.

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor:
"The secret is simply to know what you're going to do before you even see the possibilities."
—Porlema'ko, mind mage

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor: "The specimen seems to be broken."

quotes.name: Wall of Stone
quotes.flavor: The ground itself lends its strength to these walls of living stone, which possess the stability of ancient mountains. These mighty bulwarks thwart ground-based troops, providing welcome relief for weary warriors who defend the land.

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Fleeting Distraction
quotes.flavor: The first spell taught to young mages, it has spared the lives of many whose hands are too small to hold a sword.

quotes.name: Settle Beyond Reality
quotes.flavor: Two taken, two judged, one returned.

quotes.name: Plague Sliver
quotes.flavor: A sliver shares everything with its hive—even its afflictions.

quotes.name: Juniper Order Ranger
quotes.flavor: To protect the alliance between Kjeldor and Yavimaya, they trained in the ways of both.

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

quotes.name: Bladestitched Skaab
quotes.flavor: The surviving militia members reunited with their fallen comrades sooner than they'd hoped.

quotes.name: Gisela, the Broken Blade // Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.

quotes.name: Zaffai and the Tempests
quotes.flavor: "Leave everything on the stage and give them a performance they'll never forget."

quotes.name: Goblin Shrine
quotes.flavor:
"I knew it weren't no ordinary pile of—you know."
—Norin the Wary

quotes.name: Curse of Verbosity
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Idle chatter beckons many an attentive ear.

quotes.name: Umara Entangler
quotes.flavor: "Sea Gate is gone, the Halimar basin empty. But rebuild the seawall and give these waters time, and they will fill the basin anew."

quotes.name: Tempered Steel
quotes.flavor:
"Death shall prevail as long as our will falls to rust. May necessity anneal our resolve."
—Ghalma the Shaper

quotes.name: Afflict
quotes.flavor: One rarely notices a heartbeat, save when it is stolen.

quotes.name: Death Baron
quotes.flavor: For the necromancer barons, killing and recruitment are one and the same.

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

quotes.name: Nightveil Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"We're on the fortieth floor, with one window, no balcony. No one could possibly get in."
—Minosz, Orzhov chief of security

quotes.name: Idle Thoughts
quotes.flavor: Inspiration strikes the uncluttered mind.

quotes.name: Morbid Opportunist
quotes.flavor:
"Great people here! You can trust everything they say!"
—Zozo resident

quotes.name: Valakut Awakening // Valakut Stoneforge
quotes.flavor:
"My ancestors reshaped the world to their vision. I have a few ideas of my own."
—Tars Olan, stoneforge mystic

quotes.name: Lake-town Lookout
quotes.flavor: "Look! The lights again! Last night the watchmen saw them start and fade from midnight until dawn. Something is happening up there."

quotes.name: Carnage Gladiator
quotes.flavor: Not the foulest or bloodiest act at Rix Maadi by a stretch.

quotes.name: Time Ebb
quotes.flavor:
"Gone today, here tomorrow."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Dragonscale Boon
quotes.flavor:
"When we were lost and weary, the ainok showed us how to survive. They have earned the right to call themselves Abzan, and to wear the Scale."
—Anafenza, khan of the Abzan

quotes.name: Blade Instructor
quotes.flavor: "Watch carefully. The gap between death and victory is thinner than your blade."

quotes.name: Propaganda
quotes.flavor: P is for Perception. A measure of your environmental and situational awareness. It directly affects weapon accuracy in V.A.T.S., lock-picking skills, and successful attempts at stealing items.

quotes.name: Rally the Ancestors
quotes.flavor:
"The family is a tree, and in times of need, every branch can be a weapon."
—Daghatar the Adamant

quotes.name: Force of Will
quotes.flavor: 2023 Europe Legacy Championship

quotes.name: Lost Soul
quotes.flavor: Her hand gently beckons, she whispers your name—but those who go with her are never the same.

quotes.name: Rupture
quotes.flavor: All creatures have an inner fire. Releasing it can be dangerous.

quotes.name: Defective Detective
quotes.flavor: Nothing gets by her . . . except the evidence, the motive, and the culprit.

quotes.name: Imperial Recruiter
quotes.flavor: Gather your party, the quest begins.

quotes.name: Gideon's Sacrifice
quotes.flavor: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

quotes.name: Mage-Ring Bully
quotes.flavor: "Don't be rude, Beleren. We just want to enjoy the view with you."

quotes.name: Gloomwidow
quotes.flavor: When gloomwidows mature, they abandon venom in favor of massive webs that span the eaves of cliffs.

quotes.name: Omenspeaker
quotes.flavor: Her prophecies amaze her even as she speaks them.

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

quotes.name: Charging Monstrosaur
quotes.flavor: "I knew I should have stayed with the boat. Always stay with the boat!"

quotes.name: Serene Remembrance
quotes.flavor: While Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched, Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past.
